scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.
Agent researched a disjoint batch; integration and structural checks are not independent historical certification.
Imported border coordinates remain unchanged. Historical events and map coverage are distinguished in prose; see batchIdentityNotes for conflicts.

proposedOverrides.summary: Changing interior Pacific Northwest atlas umbrella, circa 1500 BCE to 1600 CE, preserved under its typo-bearing id.

batchIdentityNotes: The exact id and display label preserve the atlas typo fichers; public copy explains that fishers was apparently intended.
Twenty-seven target features form nine exact coordinate signatures plus five absent controls.

The early one-part polygon spans interior British Columbia, Washington, Oregon, Idaho and western Montana while excluding coast and lower Columbia samples, so the label is not literal cultural geography.
The 1500 geometry adds a hole around sampled Nimiipuu-area points; 1530 leaves one tiny central Washington sliver plus a northern component.
The 1492 gap and 1600 endpoint are atlas seams rather than population absence, migration dates, collapse or extinction.
Named Plateau peoples, nations and languages remain distinct; archaeological, scientific, late comparative and living evidence are labeled by place and time.
No written sample is supplied because no contemporaneous text securely represents the exact umbrella across its footprint and interval.
